description.value:
Prerequisites worshipper of a deity or pantheon

The traditions of these large tattoos, often stretching over the back or shoulders, have been passed from Tang Mai's tree-keeping priests to their students across Tian Xia.

Activate—Soul Blessing f (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You take an action with the rage, stance, or tandem trait

Effect The tattoo purifies your mind and body, reducing your clumsy, enfeebled, frightened, or stupefied condition by 1.

Special While you are under the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Rage], the Soul Blessing action gains the rage trait.
